therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and immune response enhancement
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: safety and tolerability (dose-limiting toxicities, adverse events)

results.effect_size: ORR: 8 responses across combination arms, 0 responses with monotherapy
results.target_engagement_evidence: Peripheral OX40 receptor occupancy >80% achieved in BMS-986178 + nivolumab arms
biomarker_changes: Peripheral OX40 receptor occupancy on CD4+ T cells and Tregs demonstrated
Sustained T cell expansion assessed with DPV-001 vaccine
subgroup_findings: Responses observed only in combination arms (BMS-986178 + nivolumab ± ipilimumab)
No responses in BMS-986178 monotherapy arms
safety_signals: High rates of adverse events (nearly all participants)
Serious adverse events in majority of participants
Grade 3-4 laboratory abnormalities including hepatotoxicity, electrolyte disturbances
Immune-related adverse events expected with checkpoint inhibitor combinations
results.dose_information: BMS-986178: 20-320 mg Q2W or Q4W or Q12W; Nivolumab: 240 mg Q2W or 480 mg Q4W; Ipilimumab: 1-3 mg/kg Q3W or Q6W
